summary.intent: Improve the quality of JSON summaries for changes in the ask_soony service, recompute them, restart the service, and verify the public dashboard shows the latest drop with summaries.
summary.outcome: Better JSON summaries were implemented in src/ask_soony/changes.py, recomputed, committed, and the service was restarted and running. The latest poll showed no changes, so the dashboard check printed nothing and the summaries were inspected directly via JSON output.

repo: The service polls for changes; a poll with no new changes produces no output, so an empty check does not indicate failure.
Summaries are computed in src/ask_soony/changes.py and need a recompute plus service restart to appear on the public dashboard.

code.finding: Modified to produce better JSON summaries for changes; specific line ranges were not referenced in the transcript.

workflow: When a poll-based check yields no output because nothing changed, inspect the underlying JSON data directly to verify results.
Verify user-facing output (public dashboard) after recompute and restart rather than assuming success.

friction: The dashboard fetch check printed nothing because the latest poll had no changes, so it could not confirm the summaries and a separate direct JSON inspection was needed.
open_items: Confirm on the public dashboard that the latest drop displays the improved summaries once new changes arrive.
